blockedReason: Scope 1's exposure measurement (SCN-028-01) is done and evidence-backed. The owner decision (SCN-028-02) required to complete Scope 1 has not been recorded — it is reserved for the human owner and must not be made by an implementing agent (see spec.md and uservalidation.md).
filingNote: Filed 2026-08-29 as the spec-filed disposition required by Gate G095 for a discovered issue BUG-012 recorded as 'out of scope rather than done'. Under the Discovered-Issue Disposition rule a disposition is discharged by CREATING the tracked artifact, not by narrating the finding, so this packet exists on disk as of that turn. It is a design decision with defensible alternatives rather than a defect with one correct fix, which is why it is a spec and not a bug.

executionHistory.summary: Filed this packet as the spec-filed disposition for a discovered issue in BUG-012. No scope work was started and no phase was executed, so phasesExecuted is empty rather than populated with claims nothing has earned.

Implemented and executed the read-only exposure measurement (TP-028-01, TP-028-REG1) required by Scope 1: scripts/measure-provenance-exposure.mjs, run against the full 292-file/150,127-row corpus, non-mutation proven by corpus hash before/after. Result recorded in design.md. Deliberately did NOT record an owner decision for SCN-028-02 — spec.md and uservalidation.md both reserve that decision for the human owner, and an implementing agent choosing it would settle the policy by proxy. Scope 1 and this spec remain not done.
